description: Blockchain development, in this course Dive into the world of blockchain development and master the skills needed to build decentralized applications. This course covers the fundamentals of blockchain technology, smart contracts, and decentralized finance (DeFi). Learn how to create secure and scalable blockchain solutions using popular platforms like Ethereum and Hyperledger. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced developer, this course will guide you through the essential tools, coding practices, and frameworks needed to excel in blockchain development. Gain hands-on experience with Solidity, Web3.js, and more to build real-world blockchain applications. Start your journey today. Programming with Mosh
